blocks.text: Data collection ka matlab hai kisi khaas maqsad ke liye relevant (kaam ki) information jama karna. Research ki qism ke hisab se alag alag tareeqe istemal hote hain: surveys, observations (ghaur se dekhna) aur experiments (tajurbe). Har tareeqe ki apni khoobiyan hain aur har ek kisi khaas situation mein behtar kaam karta hai. Sahi tareeqa research ke objective (maqsad) aur zaroori data ki qism par depend karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Naye product ke bare mein bohat se logon ki raye jaanne ke liye kaunsa tareeqa sahi rahega?
blocks.explanation: Survey, kyun ke is mein bohat se logon se ek jaise sawal pooche jate hain.

items: Data jama karne ke tareeqe: surveys, observations, experiments; maqsad aur data ki qism dekh kar select karein.
